name: the Homelands
note: A zone of the disc for each race of racedefs past the game's, where it stands on the disc (no two in one cell of the grid). Built by cmd/worldbuild from the operator's disc; the content (start, people, quests) is tools/seed_race_homes.py's.

zones.name: West Plateau
zones.note: Hill Giant: the hill giants' plateau: 73 hill giants of the game stand in it (West Plateau, cell 3,1)

home.flavor: Hill Giants are towering folk of the West Plateau in the Homelands, whose young cross the sea to train beside the ogres of Oggok.

npcs.name: Elder Hrolmog
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the tooth thong; the spiritmaster and the coachman); a hill giant at the foot of the old steps

npcs.name: Stonehand Borrik
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps south-east of the newcomer, beside the elder: a plateau sentinel's look

npcs.name: Hidewife Marna
npcs.note: the camp's outfitter, a few steps south-west of the elder: hands over the level 1 tooth thong and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol)

npcs.name: Grocer Bulka
npcs.note: the camp's grocer, an Oggok grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ognarr
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Coachman Durgo
npcs.note: the camp's stable, on the open plain south of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a young giant that casts has its spells; north-west of the elder, past the grocer; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thundrik
npcs.note: sends a young giant who has done the five starter quests to Oggok (the quest The Stone Way); by the standing stones north of the camp

npcs.name: plateau skink
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's skinks (a plains basilisk's body, small), at the plain's own creatures' spots west of the camp (moved in from the far pits: the nearest is 130 off, not 240)

npcs.name: rock badger
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's badgers (the badger's body), at the plain's own creatures' spots south of the camp (two on the plain's own height)

npcs.name: Greyjaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (a grey wolf's body, large), alone at a wyrm's spot far north of the camp, 80 beyond the gatekeeper; hostile

Gatekeeper Thundrik: Not yet, little one. The stone way is for giants the plateau has tested.
Do what Elder Hrolmog and Stonehand Borrik ask. Then come back.
Plateau sentinel: Hmm. All quiet. The rhinos are far off.
Keep off the old steps, %r. The dead up there do not like company.
New one? Elder Hrolmog stands at the foot of the old steps.
Elder Hrolmog: A giant is a stone that walks, %p. Walk slow. Fall on what needs falling on.
The ogres are loud. You will get used to it.
Stonehand Borrik: Big steps, %p. Small ones waste the day.
Hit it once. If it gets up, hit it again.

zones.name: Kerra Isle
zones.note: Kerran: the kerrans' island, its village and sentries (Kerra Isle, cell 2,3)

home.flavor: Kerrans are a proud feline people of the stilt villages of Kerra Isle in the Homelands, whose young cross the sea to train in Qeynos.

npcs.name: Elder Ssharu
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the claw band; the spiritmaster and the coachman); in a kerran priest's robe, on the village's landward side

npcs.name: Huntress Kazhra
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps south of the newcomer, beside the elder: an isle sentinel's look

npcs.name: Weaver Shimra
npcs.note: the village's outfitter, under the first stilt house north-east of the elder (a kerran soldier's spot on the ground): hands over the level 1 claw band and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol)

npcs.name: Grocer Miyanne
npcs.note: the village's grocer by the water, a Qeynos grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Talhrin
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Coachman Tolhra
npcs.note: the isle's stable, on the open grass north-west of the elder, on the landward side: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach (and the ferry that carries it) runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a cub that casts has its spells; a kerran priest's look at a kerran wizard's spot east of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Raszhar
npcs.note: at the water's edge north-east of the village: sends a cub who has done the five starter quests to Qeynos (the quest Across the Water)

npcs.name: isle crab
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's crabs (a sandcrawler crab's body, small), on the sand spit north of the village

npcs.name: fern viper
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's snakes (the grass viper's body, small), among the ferns and palms west and south-west of the village, on the ground's own heights

npcs.name: Old Snapclaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the crab's body, half as big again), alone at a millipede's spot on the island's far south-west; hostile

Gatekeeper Raszhar: Not yet, cub. The water is wide, and you have not earned the crossing.
Do what Elder Ssharu and Huntress Kazhra ask of you. Then come to me at the water's edge.
Isle sentinel: The tide is quiet, %r. So am I.
Walk softly on the stilts, cub. The elders are sleeping. The elders are always sleeping.
A new cub? Elder Ssharu stands on the landward side.
Elder Ssharu: A kerran lands on its feet, %p. See that you do.
The humans mean well. Do not scratch them unless you must.
Huntress Kazhra: Ears up, %p. The ferns hide more than they show.

zones.name: Envar
zones.note: Jal'Raeth: the Rathe's Envar, where the game's own Jal'Raeth stand: 29 of them, commoners, nobles, channelers, knights and champions, among the ruins (Envar, cell 2,4). Added 2026-11-10, after the plan: the race joined after it.

home.flavor: The Jal'Raeth are a silent folk who drift in meditation round the old temple of Envar in the Homelands; Highbourne's scholars take them in.

npcs.name: Elder Ithrael
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the prayer beads; the spiritmaster and the coachman); a Jal'Raeth channeler, on the road before the temple's east door

npcs.name: Watcher Vaeris
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), on the road a few steps south of the elder: a sentinel's look

npcs.name: Artificer Maelis
npcs.note: the order's outfitter, on the road's north side: hands over the level 1 prayer beads and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol)

npcs.name: Grocer Saelun
npcs.note: the order's grocer on the road's north side, a Highbourne grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Oravai
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Coachman Therun
npcs.note: the order's stable, on the road north-east of the elder (open floor): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a novice that casts has its spells; a channeler's look, on the road's south side; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Tavrin
npcs.note: at the temple's east door: sends one who has done the five starter quests to Highbourne (the quest The Scholars' City)

npcs.name: ash grub
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's grubs (a moth larva's body, small), in the dead hills where the east road runs out

npcs.name: cinder adder
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's snakes (the copperhead's body, small), on the low hills north-east of the road (the first at a beetle's own spot, the rest on the ground's own heights)

npcs.name: Hollow Pilgrim
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe: one of the temple's dead that wandered out (an Envaric zombie's look), alone at a revenant's spot on the hill east of the grubs; hostile

Gatekeeper Tavrin: Not yet. The door opens for a still mind, and yours is still loud.
Do what Elder Ithrael and Watcher Vaeris ask of you. Then return to me.
Envar sentinel: The dead of the temple keep to the temple, %r. Mostly.
A novice? Elder Ithrael waits on the road before the east door.
Elder Ithrael: Stillness is not silence, %p. It is what remains when the noise is spent.
The scholars will ask you a great many questions. Answer the ones worth answering.
Watcher Vaeris: The hills are dead, %p. What moves in them is not ours.

zones.name: Moss Mouth Cavern
zones.note: Goblin: a goblin cavern town: 87 goblins of the game, a blacksmith among them (Moss Mouth Cavern, cell 9,6)

home.flavor: Goblins are crafty folk of Moss Mouth Cavern in the Homelands, quick with a blade and quicker to flee, who serve the dark elves of Neriak.

npcs.name: Elder Snikkit
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a witch doctor's look, in the middle of the cavern's great hall

npcs.name: Grocer Mudgrub
npcs.note: the cavern's grocer, in the blacksmith's look, a Neriak grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Grizzik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a goblin seer's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Skabber
npcs.note: sends a goblin who has done the starter quests to Neriak (the quest The Road to Neriak); a goblin warrior's look; on open floor before the east huts

npcs.name: Pitmaster Grukk
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps from the elder on the hall's open floor: a goblin warrior's arms

npcs.name: Stitcher Nibb
npcs.note: the cavern's outfitter, across the hall from the elder (open floor): hands over the level 1 ear ring and the level 4 materials; a Neriak tailor's cloth (Tailor Desrez)

npcs.name: Coachman Rukkit
npcs.note: the cavern's stable, in the south chamber down the passage from the hall (open floor, clear of the huts): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open floor, nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), in a witch doctor's look; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: tunnel rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats, at the goblins' spots in the long west tunnel that runs south from the hall and down its slope to the cavern's mouth

npcs.name: cave bat
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's bats (the bat's body, smaller), at the enthralled goblins' spots in the far north-east chamber

npcs.name: Mother Mossweb
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the black widow's body), alone in the old camp outside the cavern's mouth, far to the south, at a witch doctor's spot; hostile

Gatekeeper Skabber: Not so fast, little one. Do what Elder Snikkit asks of you first, then come back to me.
No one leaves Moss Mouth until the elder says so. He waits in the middle of the great hall.
Moss Mouth lookout: Keep moving, %r. Lookouts do not chat.
If you hear something in the dark, it is probably a rat. Probably.
New, are you? Elder Snikkit wants to see every new face. He waits in the middle of the hall.
Elder Snikkit: Mind Mudgrub and mind Skabber, and you will do well, little one.
A goblin who keeps his ears open lives long enough to grow wise. Look at me.
Pitmaster Grukk: Keep your knife where you can reach it, %p.
Rats, bats, spiders. The dark is never empty. Remember that in Neriak.

zones.name: Aviak Village
zones.note: Aviak: the aviaks' savannah village: 173 aviaks of the game, a grocer and guards among them (Aviak Village, cell 4,10)

home.flavor: Aviaks are watchful bird folk of the savannah aeries in the Homelands, whose fledglings fly north to fight beside the barbarians of Halas.

npcs.name: Elder Kraawk
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the wingband; the spiritmaster and the coachman), in the high priest's robes

npcs.name: Huntmaster Arrok
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a high guard's armour

npcs.name: Weaver Tikkri
npcs.note: the Roost's outfitter: hands over the level 1 wingband and the level 4 materials; a Halas tailor's cloth (Tailor McQuaid)

npcs.name: Grocer Skreel
npcs.note: the Roost's grocer, Halas's grocer's food (Grocer Hannibal)

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Kreeal
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Coachman Harrek
npcs.note: the Roost's stable: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open floor, no creature near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a fledgling caster has its spells; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Windwhistle
npcs.note: sends a fledgling who has done the five starter quests to Halas (the quest The Long Flight)

npcs.name: scrub rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (the grave rat's body, small), at the zone's own creatures' spots on the grass north of the nests

npcs.name: brush wasp
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's wasps (the huge wasp's body, half its size), at the zone's own creatures' spots on the hill west of the nests

npcs.name: Razortusk
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (a boar's body), at a wild boar's spot on the rise east of the nests; hostile

Gatekeeper Windwhistle: The north wind is not for you yet, fledgling. Finish what the elder and the huntmaster ask of you first.
When Arrok says you are ready, I will send you to Halas. Not before.
Roost sentinel: Keep to the grass, fledgling. The lions keep to the far hills.
Watch the sky, %p. It tells you everything.
Elder Kraawk: The Roost remembers every fledgling it sends north.
Huntmaster Arrok: A hunter who watches the grass eats. One who does not is eaten.

zones.name: Cazic-Thule
zones.note: Lizardman: the Tae Ew lizardmen's temple in the swamp (Cazic-Thule, cell 7,15)

home.flavor: Lizardmen are cold-blooded hunters of the swamps of Cazic-Thule in the Homelands, patient and tireless, who sell their blades in Freeport.

npcs.name: Elder Hsslarn
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in a hierophant's robes, on the west shore before the old temple

npcs.name: Grocer Sskaya
npcs.note: the swamp's grocer at the long bridge's west end, in the race's own body; a Freeport grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Thessik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; before the old temple

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Vosskar
npcs.note: sends a lizardman who has done the starter quests to Freeport (The Road to Freeport); on the east island, over the long bridge

npcs.name: Huntmaster Kessrak
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps from the elder: a Tae Ew devastator's look

npcs.name: Hidebinder Ssilith
npcs.note: the Mirewatch's outfitter, just east of the elder: hands over the level 1 fang cord and the level 4 materials; a Freeport tailor's cloth (Tailor Bariston); a lizardman caitiff's look

npcs.name: Coachman Rassk
npcs.note: the Mirewatch's stable, south-east of the elder and short of the east bridge: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open ground, nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), in a hierophant's look; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: bog beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (the huge beetle's body, smaller), on the south shore of the temple island

npcs.name: marsh serpent
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's serpents (the anaconda's body, small), at the south end of the east island

npcs.name: Old Snapjaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the alligator's body), alone on the north shore, just west of the north bridge's far end; hostile

Gatekeeper Vosskar: Not yet, hatchling. Elder Hsslarn has work for you first.
Every hatchling sees the elder before it sees Freeport. He waits on the west shore, before the old temple.
Mirewatch sentinel: The water is calm today. Calm water hides the most.
Stay on the bridges, %r. The mud has no bottom in places.
New to the swamp? Elder Hsslarn waits on the west shore, before the old temple.
Elder Hsslarn: Patience, hatchling. The swamp rewards those who wait.
Keep your scales dry and your blade sharp, and the mainland will treat you well.
Huntmaster Kessrak: Still water, still mind, %p. Then strike.
A hunter who hurries feeds the swamp. Remember it in Freeport.

zones.name: Sylhilthis' Dwell
zones.note: Kappa: the kappa town of Odus: 179 kappa of the game, guards and a blacksmith (Sylhilthis' Dwell, cell 2,1)

home.flavor: Kappa are a hardy shelled river folk of Sylhilthis' Dwell in the Homelands, whose young go down the river to the halflings of Rivervale.

npcs.name: Elder Hoshuk
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the shell charm; the spiritmaster and the coachman): a kappa shaman, on the sand south of the Dwell

npcs.name: Grocer Pemmi
npcs.note: the Dwell's grocer on the east sand, a Rivervale grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Oruko
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Kabbo
npcs.note: on the causeway: sends a young kappa who has done the starter quests to Rivervale (the quest Down the River)

npcs.name: Reedwarden Tsumo
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a kappa warrior

npcs.name: Netmender Ishiko
npcs.note: the Dwell's outfitter, on the sand west of the elder: hands over the level 1 shell charm and the level 4 materials; a Rivervale tailor's cloth (Tailor Vali)

npcs.name: Coachman Dobu
npcs.note: the Dwell's stable, on the open sand south of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a kappa wizard on the sand east of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: marsh rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (a grave rat's body), on the shore where the causeway comes in, south-east of the Dwell

npcs.name: mudfang basilisk
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's basilisks (the plains basilisk's body, half its size), at the zone's own creatures' spots on the flats south of the rats

npcs.name: Gulpjaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the blue basilisk's body), alone at a basilisk's spot on the east shore; hostile

Gatekeeper Kabbo: The river is not for you yet, young one. Finish what the elder and the reedwarden ask of you first.
When Tsumo says your shell is hard enough, I will send you down the river. Not before.
Dwell sentinel: Keep to the causeway, young one. The deep water keeps its own.
All is calm on the water.
A dry shell cracks, %p. Wade often.
Elder Hoshuk: May the current carry you well, %p.
The Dwell remembers every shell that leaves it.
Reedwarden Tsumo: Keep your shell between you and their teeth, %p.
Slow water runs deep. Do not hurry a hunt.

zones.name: Mayfly Glade
zones.note: Brownie: a glade (the brownies' own Salisearaneen stands in the Warrens' cell) (Mayfly Glade, cell 5,9)

home.flavor: Brownies are quick-fingered fae of Mayfly Glade in the Homelands, fond of mischief and a good meal, and friends to the halflings of Rivervale.

npcs.name: Elder Thimbleroot
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a brownie elder of Salisearaneen's, east of the hut in the glade's stockade (the Glinaldal camp's spots: no brownie stands in the zone)

npcs.name: Grocer Pippkin
npcs.note: the glade's larder by the tent, a Rivervale grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Fennick
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Burrowby
npcs.note: sends a brownie who has done the starter quests to Rivervale (The Road to Rivervale); at the stockade's gate

npcs.name: Hedgewarden Tansy
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps north of the elder inside the stockade: a brownie guard's look

npcs.name: Weaver Mossbutton
npcs.note: the glade's outfitter, at the north side of the stockade: hands over the level 1 sash and the level 4 materials; a Rivervale tailor's cloth (Tailor Celly)

npcs.name: Coachman Twigg
npcs.note: the glade's stable, on the grass outside the east gate: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open grass, nothing that attacks near); the red-capped little fellow's body (the brownie elder's of the disc)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a brownie elder's look; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Glade watcher
npcs.note: outside the gate, on the ground

npcs.name: mayfly swarm
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's mayflies (the dragonflies' body), in the hollow among the trees south of the stockade

npcs.name: glade snake
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's snakes (the grass viper's body), in the woods west of the stockade

npcs.name: Old Greyback
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the badger's body, large), alone in the woods far north-west of the stockade; hostile

Gatekeeper Burrowby: Off to Rivervale already? Not before the elder has had a word with you. He is just inside, by the hut.
Elder Thimbleroot first, then me. That is the way of the glade.
Glade watcher: Lovely day for it, whatever it is.
Keep your fingers out of Pippkin's larder, %r. She counts more than she says.
The stockade keeps out the wolves. Mostly.
Elder Thimbleroot: A brownie with a full belly is a brownie ready for anything.
Rivervale is a fine place. The halflings bake almost as well as we do.
Hedgewarden Tansy: Mind the hedge, %p, and the hedge will mind you.
Quick feet, sharp eyes, full pockets. That is all a brownie needs.

zones.name: Misty Thicket
zones.note: Pixie: the bixies' thicket (Misty Thicket, cell 8,5)

home.flavor: Pixies are tiny winged fae of the Misty Thicket in the Homelands, bright as sparks and twice as quick, who learn the old magic among the elves.

npcs.name: Elder Brightwing
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, under the tall pines in the middle of the thicket, at the bixies' spots

npcs.name: Grocer Nettlewick
npcs.note: the thicket's grocer by the old pines to the east, an elven grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Glimmerdew
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl
npcs.note: sends a pixie who has done the starter quests to the elves, Tethelin or Fayspire by class (The Elves' Wood)

npcs.name: Huntress Thistledown
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps north of the elder under the pines

npcs.name: Spinner Gossamer
npcs.note: the thicket's outfitter, a few steps south-east of the elder: hands over the level 1 ring and the level 4 materials; a Fayspire tailor's cloth (Tailor Everleaf)

npcs.name: Coachman Fernwick
npcs.note: the thicket's stable, on open ground south-east of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name); left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: bramble rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (the rat's body, small), in the brambles south-west of the pines, well clear of the elder

npcs.name: thicket beetle
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's beetles (the huge beetle's body, small), on the low ground east of the pines

npcs.name: Redsting
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the flame hornet's body), alone in the woods far south of the pines; hostile

Gatekeeper Thistlewhirl: Not yet, little spark. Elder Brightwing wants a word with you first.
Every pixie sees the elder before the elves see the pixie. Off you go!
Thicket warden: Watch the brambles, %r. The rats are bolder than they look.
Mist on the leaves means rain by evening.
Lost? Elder Brightwing is under the tall pines in the middle of the thicket.
Elder Brightwing: The thicket remembers every pixie it has raised. It will remember you.
Be quick, be kind, and never let a goblin near your purse.
Huntress Thistledown: Wings tucked, eyes open, %p. That is the whole of hunting.
The thicket hides us because we let it. Never trample what hides you.

zones.name: Twisted Tower
zones.note: Fairy: a faerie town: a blacksmith, druids and wizards of the game (Twisted Tower, cell 3,5)

home.flavor: Fairies are winged fae of the Twisted Tower in the Homelands, quick to laugh and light as thistledown, who go to the humans of Qeynos.

npcs.name: Elder Moonpetal
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, in the middle of the faeries' valley, at Sprinkletine's spot

npcs.name: Grocer Dewberry
npcs.note: the faerie grocer's look, by the old forge; a Qeynos grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Lirelle
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Starling
npcs.note: sends a fairy who has done the starter quests to Qeynos, its rangers and druids to Surefall Glade (The Road to Qeynos); toward the pass

npcs.name: Warden Larkspur
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps east of the elder: a faerie guard's look

npcs.name: Petalweaver Lissa

npcs.name: Coachman Tumbleseed
npcs.note: the valley's stable, on the open grass north-west of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name); left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: dusk beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (the fire beetle's body, smaller), at the west end of the valley

npcs.name: valley raven
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's ravens (the raven's body), among the trees east of the elder, half way to the valley's east end

npcs.name: Cindersnap
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the fire drake's body, half its size: a young drake), alone at the far east end of the valley; hostile

Gatekeeper Starling: Not yet, little friend. Elder Moonpetal is waiting to meet you.
Elder Moonpetal sees every new fairy first. She is in the middle of the valley, south of here.
Tower watcher: The pass is quiet today. Good.
Mind the drakes up on the slopes, %r. They do not care how small you are.
If you are new, see Elder Moonpetal. Everyone does.
Elder Moonpetal: Laugh often, little friend. It is the oldest magic there is.
The valley will always remember you, wherever the winds take you.
Warden Larkspur: Light feet and a light heart, %p. The rest is practice.
The cliffs keep the world out. We keep the valley. Remember us in Qeynos.

zones.name: Blackburrow
zones.note: Gnoll: the gnolls' burrow: 124 gnolls of the game (Blackburrow, cell 6,6)

home.flavor: Gnolls are hyena-faced hunters of Blackburrow in the Homelands, cunning in a pack and fierce alone, who serve the dark elves of Neriak.

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Brindle
npcs.note: sends a gnoll who has done the starter quests to Neriak (The Road to Neriak); at the stockade's south-east gate

npcs.name: Elder Grawl
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a gnoll spiritist's look, on the yard's open floor just east of the fire pit (the pit behind him)

npcs.name: Grocer Snaggle
npcs.note: the burrow's grocer, south of the fire pit; a Neriak grocer's food (Grocer Droel)

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Rakk
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a gnoll shaman's look; on open floor between the tents, a few steps east of the elder

npcs.name: Packleader Varg
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a gnoll soldier's look

npcs.name: Hidescraper Yipp
npcs.note: the burrow's outfitter, a few steps south of the elder, by the tents: hands over the level 1 collar and the level 4 materials; a Neriak tailor's cloth (Tailor Eroz); a gnoll forager's look

npcs.name: Coachman Skulk
npcs.note: the burrow's stable, on the road outside the south-east gate: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open road, nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a gnoll shaman's look; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: hill badger
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's badgers (the badger's body, smaller), on the hill north-west of the stockade

npcs.name: ridge viper
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's vipers (the copperhead's body), in the scrub south of the stockade

npcs.name: Greymuzzle
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the wolf's body), alone on the rise far north-east of the stockade; hostile

Gatekeeper Brindle: Not yet, pup. Elder Grawl has to know your scent before Neriak does.
Go and see Elder Grawl by the fire. Then we will talk.
Burrow guard: Nothing moves on the hill that I do not see.
Keep your nose up, %r. Trouble smells before it shows.
New pup? Elder Grawl is by the fire pit.
Elder Grawl: The pack is strong because each gnoll is strong. Remember that.
Wherever you go, pup, the pack goes with you.
Packleader Varg: A gnoll alone is a meal. A pack is a hunt. Find your pack in Neriak.

zones.name: Thedruk
zones.note: Orc: the Hatebone orcs' camp: 93 orcs of the game, a prophet among them (Thedruk, cell 9,4)

home.flavor: Orcs are tusked warriors of the Thedruk camps in the Homelands, hard as stone, who keep a rough peace with the barbarians of Halas.

npcs.name: Elder Gorruk
npcs.note: the starter quests' giver, a prophet's look, among the totems of the Hatebone camp east of the river

npcs.name: Grocer Bulgash
npcs.note: a henchman's look, at the camp's cook fire; a Halas grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Urzog
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a mystic's look

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thrakka
npcs.note: sends an orc who has done the starter quests to Halas (The Road to Halas); a scout's look

npcs.name: Warleader Krugg
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps east of the elder, clear of the round huts: an orc brute's look

npcs.name: Hidecutter Marga
npcs.note: the camp's outfitter, south-west of the elder: hands over the level 1 war band and the level 4 materials; a Halas tailor's cloth (Tailor Freya)

npcs.name: Coachman Dursh
npcs.note: the camp's stable, on open ground south of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (nothing that attacks near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), an orc mystic's look; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: camp rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (the rat's body), in the grass west of the camp, beyond the bare hill

npcs.name: scree spider
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's spiders (the stone spider's body, half its size), among the rocks north of the camp

npcs.name: Old Scarback
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the young black bear's body), alone on the slope far south of the camp; hostile

Gatekeeper Thrakka: Not yet, whelp. Elder Gorruk speaks to every new orc first.
Go and see the elder among the totems. Then come back, and I will send you to Halas.
Thedruk sentry: The camp sleeps easier when I do not.
Looking for the elder? He is among the totems in the middle of the camp.
Elder Gorruk: An orc is measured by the fights he finishes, not the ones he starts.
Warleader Krugg: Stand straight, %p. An orc who slouches is an orc who loses.
Hit first. Hit last. What comes between is noise.

zones.name: The Warrens
zones.note: Kobold: the kobolds' tunnels: 114 of clan Kolbok (The Warrens, cell 4,4)

home.flavor: Kobolds are small, furred diggers of the Warrens in the Homelands, whose pups trade their tunnel lore with the gnomes of Klick'Anon.

npcs.name: Elder Grikkis
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the digging sash; the spiritmaster and the coachman), in a high shaman's skull, by the cavern's stalls

npcs.name: Grocer Snivvet
npcs.note: the cavern's grocer at the stalls, a Klick'Anon grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Kraaz
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Ruknar
npcs.note: sends a pup who has done the starter quests to Klick'Anon (the quest The Deep Ways)

npcs.name: Packleader Yarrk
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a clan battlemaster's look

npcs.name: Stitcher Vikka
npcs.note: the cavern's outfitter, west of the elder: hands over the level 1 digging sash and the level 4 materials; a Klick'Anon tailor's cloth (Tailor Tavin)

npcs.name: Coachman Drekk
npcs.note: the cavern's stable, south of the elder, facing the open floor to his south (a wall is at his back): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a clan mystic west of the stalls; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: tunnel beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (a fire beetle's body, small), at the cavern's west end

npcs.name: deepway millipede
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's millipedes (the millipede's body, half its size), at the clan's own spots in the south tunnels

npcs.name: Gravelmaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the scythe beetle's body), alone at a guardian's spot in the far chamber past the south tunnels; hostile

Gatekeeper Ruknar: The deep ways are not for you yet, pup. Do what the elder and the packleader ask of you first.
When Yarrk says your teeth are in, I will send you to Klick'Anon. Not before.
Warren sentinel: Keep to the lit tunnels, pup.
Yip! All quiet in the warren.
Elder Grikkis: Clan Kolbok remembers every pup it sends out.
Packleader Yarrk: Keep your snout low and your tail lower, %p.
A pup that hunts alone is a meal. Remember the pack.

zones.name: Gerntar Mines
zones.note: Minotaur: the Rustel minotaurs' mines: 41 minotaurs of the game (Gerntar Mines, cell 6,13)

home.flavor: Minotaurs are bull-headed brutes of the Gerntar Mines in the Homelands, proud and quick to anger, who throw in their lot with the trolls of Grobb.

npcs.name: Elder Hornbrand
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the nose ring; the spiritmaster and the coachman); Gilthirn Ironhoof's look, in the mouth of the Rustel minotaurs' mine

npcs.name: Warden Ironhide
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), outside the mine's mouth, a few steps from the elder: a Rustel minotaur's look

npcs.name: Smith Dargha
npcs.note: the herd's outfitter, by the old forge's stones east of the mouth: hands over the level 1 nose ring and the level 4 materials; a Grobb merchant's ore (Merchant Beldok). Rustel Elder Bribro's look (the brown beast's body)

npcs.name: Grocer Brassnose
npcs.note: by the mine cart outside; a Grobb barkeep's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ruhga
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; Khelmarak's look, at Bribro Mino's spot in the mine

npcs.name: Coachman Durruk
npcs.note: the mines' stable, on the open grass east of the old forge: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (open floor, no creature near)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a calf that casts has its spells; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Stonehoof
npcs.note: sends a minotaur who has done the five starter quests to Grobb (the quest The Road to Grobb); at the next mine's mouth to the south-east

npcs.name: mine rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (the rat's body, small), on the grass east of the mine, the first three at the savannah creatures' own spots

npcs.name: ore beetle
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's beetles (the huge beetle's body, half its size), on the low rise south-east of the mine, the first two at the savannah creatures' own spots

npcs.name: Gorespine
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (a spineback's body, small: a young one), alone at a savannah creature's spot by the water hole far east of the mine; hostile

Gatekeeper Stonehoof: Not so fast, calf. Grobb is for those the herd has tested.
Finish what Elder Hornbrand and Warden Ironhide ask of you. Then see me.
Rustel sentry: The mine is ours. Remember that.
Watch your horns in the tunnels, %r. The ceilings are low.
New calf? Elder Hornbrand stands in the mouth of the mine.
Elder Hornbrand: Pride is a fine thing, calf. So is patience. Learn both.
The herd remembers its own, wherever they roam.
Warden Ironhide: The grass feeds the herd. The herd guards the grass.

zones.name: The Vastly Deep
zones.note: Ratman: the ratmen's coast caves (The Vastly Deep, cell 5,3)

home.flavor: Ratmen are wiry, whiskered scavengers of the Vastly Deep's shore in the Homelands, whose young dig their way to the halls of Moradhim.

npcs.name: Elder Skritch
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the tideline ring; the spiritmaster and the coachman), a ratman spiritist, in the shore camp

npcs.name: Grocer Nibbla
npcs.note: the camp's grocer by the shacks, a Moradhim grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vessik
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Ksarr
npcs.note: by the water: sends a young ratman who has done the starter quests to Moradhim (the quest Into the Deep Halls)

npcs.name: Tunnelrunner Chisk
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a ratman fighter

npcs.name: Ragpicker Tikka
npcs.note: the camp's outfitter, on the sand north of the elder: hands over the level 1 tideline ring and the level 4 materials; a Moradhim tailor's cloth (Tailor Chloe)

npcs.name: Coachman Rusk
npcs.note: the camp's stable, on the open sand south-east of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a ratman wizard on the sand south-west of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: dune snake
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's snakes (a green racer snake's body), on the sand east of the camp

npcs.name: tidewrack crab
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's crabs (the crab's body, small), along the tide line south-east of the camp, round the zone's own turtle and cobra spots

npcs.name: Hoodscale
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the cobra's body), alone at a creature's spot on the rise north-east of the camp, past the dune snakes; hostile

Gatekeeper Ksarr: Hss. The deep halls are not for you yet, whisker. Do what the elder and the tunnelrunner ask of you first.
When Chisk says you are quick enough, I will send you down to Moradhim. Not before.
Deepshore sentinel: Keep off the wet rocks, whisker. The tide takes the slow.
Nothing on the wind but salt.
Elder Skritch: The camp remembers who brings back more than it took.
Tunnelrunner Chisk: Quick paws, %p. Quick paws and a quicker nose.
What the tide leaves is ours. What bites, you kill.

zones.name: East Toxxulia
zones.note: Satyr: the satyrs' woods: 155 acolyte satyrs of the game (East Toxxulia, cell 3,2)

home.flavor: Satyrs are goat-legged revelers of the East Toxxulian woods in the Homelands, whose young dance off to the elven forest round Tethelin.

npcs.name: Elder Pannoch
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the reveler's bangle; the spiritmaster and the coachman), an acolyte satyr, in the glade

npcs.name: Grocer Lyrrin
npcs.note: the glade's grocer, a faun maiden on its south side, a Tethelin grocer's food and drink

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Corvann
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster (Corvann since 2026-11-10: Mayfly Glade's spiritmaster is Fennick too, and a bind is told by its spiritmaster's name)

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Dorvan
npcs.note: sends a young satyr who has done the starter quests to its elven city (the quest The Elven Road)

npcs.name: Hornwarden Tavos
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: an acolyte satyr

npcs.name: Reedcutter Syla
npcs.note: the glade's outfitter, a faun maiden south-east of the elder: hands over the level 1 bangle and the level 4 materials; a Tethelin tailor's cloth (Tailor Everleaf)

npcs.name: Coachman Brannoc
npcs.note: the glade's stable, on the open grass east of the elder: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), an acolyte faun south-west of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: glade spiderling
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's spiderlings (a vineweb spiderling's body, small), on the grass east of the glade

npcs.name: mead wasp
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's wasps (the hornet's body, half its size), at the zone's own creatures' spots south-east of the glade

npcs.name: Nightpelt
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the shadow panther's body), alone in the hollow at the south end of the woods; hostile

Gatekeeper Dorvan: The elven road is not for you yet, kid. Dance to the elder's tune and the hornwarden's first.
When Tavos says your horns are in, I will send you to the elves. Not before.
Glade sentinel: Keep to the glade, kid. The deep woods do not dance.
Listen to the trees, %p. They carry every footstep.
Elder Pannoch: The glade keeps a song for every kid it sends away.
Hornwarden Tavos: Light hooves, %p, and a heavy hand.
A satyr who cannot fight pipes for someone else's supper.

zones.name: West Toxxulia
zones.note: Dryad: the forest dryads' woods (West Toxxulia, cell 2,2)

home.flavor: Dryads are spirits of the old trees of West Toxxulia in the Homelands, whose young go to tend the groves round Surefall Glade.

npcs.name: Elder Silverbough
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the acorn-cap earring; the spiritmaster and the coachman), a forest dryad, on the lake's west shore

npcs.name: Grocer Willowmere
npcs.note: the grove's grocer by the water, a Surefall Glade grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Ashleaf
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thornwyn
npcs.note: sends a young dryad who has done the starter quests to Qeynos or Surefall Glade (the quest Roots in the West)

npcs.name: Thornwarden Briony
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder: a forest dryad

npcs.name: Weaver Fernlight
npcs.note: the grove's outfitter, a few steps south of the elder: hands over the level 1 earring and the level 4 materials; a Qeynos tailor's cloth (Tailor Zenie)

npcs.name: Coachman Thistlewick
npcs.note: the grove's stable, on the open shore north of the elder (5440, 4915 was inside a great tree's trunk), kept by a satyr of the eastern woods: the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a forest dryad by the water south of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: bark beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (a giant scarab's body, small), in the woods west of the lake

npcs.name: rootcoil snake
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's snakes (the anaconda's body, small), deeper in the woods to the west, past the beetles

npcs.name: Rotbark
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the forest shambling's body), alone at a forest shambling's own spot at the far west edge of the woods; hostile

Gatekeeper Thornwyn: The way west is not for you yet, sapling. Do what the elder and the thornwarden ask of you first.
When Briony says your roots hold, I will send you to Qeynos. Not before.
Grove sentinel: Keep to the grove, sapling. The far woods are not all ours.
Listen to the old trees, %p. They have seen everything twice.
Elder Silverbough: The grove remembers every leaf the wind carries off.
Thornwarden Briony: Bend, %p, and you will not break.
The forest feeds those who guard it. Remember that among the humans.

zones.name: Tomb of Kings
zones.note: Skeleton: a crypt of the old kings (Tomb of Kings, cell 10,7)

home.flavor: Skeletons are the restless dead of the Tomb of Kings in the Homelands, held to their bones by a will that would not die, who walk on to Freeport.

npcs.name: Elder Ossric
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the waking band; the spiritmaster and the coachman); a Holciel noble's look, in the tomb's great hall

npcs.name: Captain Harrow
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a few steps from the elder: a Holciel guard's look, at an excavator's spot in the great hall

npcs.name: Shroudmaker Corwen
npcs.note: the tomb's outfitter, up the hall on its east side (a Holciel commoner's spot): hands over the level 1 waking band and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol). Crostell the Jeweler's look (a hexbone)

npcs.name: Grocer Marrowby
npcs.note: a Holciel commoner's look, down the hall; a Freeport grocer's food, for the living he trades with

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vellum
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; a Holciel bureaucrat's look

npcs.name: Coachman Grimsby
npcs.note: the tomb's stable, in the middle of the great hall to the north (an excavator's spot, open floor): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach, a hearse once, runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a woken caster has its spells; the summoned arcanist's look, at a commoner's spot; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Dustcloak
npcs.note: sends a skeleton who has done the five starter quests to Freeport (the quest The Road to Freeport); down the hall to the south, toward the stair

npcs.name: tomb beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (the scarab's body, half its size), in and beside the excavators' pit down the hall to the south (the excavators' own spots, and two on the walk beside the pit): the tomb's doors do not open in the client, so every hunt is in the great hall's own passage

npcs.name: crypt bat
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's bats (the marrow bat's body, small), in the passage before and beyond the pit, on its floor: each more than 30 from the robber (a creature notices at 21)

npcs.name: Tomb Robber Sela
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe: a living grave robber (Grave Robber Laen's look), alone at the far end of the south passage (a Holciel commoner's spot); hostile

Gatekeeper Dustcloak: Not yet. The living are hard on the newly woken. Finish what Elder Ossric and Captain Harrow ask of you.
When the captain says your bones will hold, I will send you to Freeport. I have waited longer for less.
Tomb sentinel: The halls are quiet. They are always quiet.
Keep to the lit halls, %r. The dark ones go on for a long way.
Newly woken? Elder Ossric is in the great hall.
Elder Ossric: Death was not an ending for us. Only a long rest, and the rest is over.
Walk among the living, and be patient with them. They have so little time.
Captain Harrow: Stand straight, %p. You have the spine for it.
The kings sleep. We do not. That is the whole of the watch.

zones.name: Guk
zones.note: Fungusman: the fungal folk's caverns (Guk's) (Guk, cell 12,14)

home.flavor: Fungusmen are slow, gentle mushroom folk of the caverns of Guk in the Homelands, whose spores drift up into the shaded glades of the elves.

npcs.name: Elder Moldcap
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the root sash; the spiritmaster and the coachman); a fungal elder of the funagl hall deep in Guk, at its own spot

npcs.name: Warden Morel
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder at a fungal elder's spot: a funagl cavalier's look (the red cap)

npcs.name: Capwright Chanter
npcs.note: the hall's outfitter, up the passage to the north-west (a froglok's spot): hands over the level 1 root sash and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol). A funagl adept's look

npcs.name: Grocer Puffstool
npcs.note: the funagl gatherer's look and spot by the hall's north wall; an elven grocer's food and drink

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Sporewell
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster; the funagl devout's look

npcs.name: Coachman Inkcap
npcs.note: the hall's stable, in the passage to the north-east (a funagl warrior's spot, open floor): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a sprout that casts has its spells; Shutaki's look (the pale cap) at Shutaki's spot; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Gillford
npcs.note: sends a fungusman who has done the five starter quests up to the elves, Tethelin or Fayspire by class (the quest Up to the Light); a funagl cavalier's spot north of the elder

npcs.name: cave beetle
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's beetles (the huge beetle's body, half its size), at the frogloks' spots in the hall's north-east passage

npcs.name: muck roach
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's roaches (the cockroach's body, small), down the east tunnel south of the beetles, on its floor

npcs.name: Old Manylegs
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (a centipede's body), alone in the spur at the east tunnel's far end; hostile

Gatekeeper Gillford: Not yet, sprout. The light above is hard on a cap that has not toughened.
Do what Elder Moldcap and Warden Morel ask of you. There is no hurry, but it must be done.
Guk sporeguard: All is quiet in the hall.
Slow and steady, %r. The caverns do not reward haste.
New sprout? Elder Moldcap is by the west wall.
Elder Moldcap: A spore that waits for the right ground grows the tallest cap.
Up above it is bright and dry. Carry a little of the damp with you.
Warden Morel: Keep to the damp, %p, and keep your cap low.
What gnaws in the dark, we tend. That is a warden's whole work.

zones.name: West Feerrott
zones.note: Wisp: the will o' wisps' swamp: 34 wisps of the game in the race's own body (0x8143DC70) float in it, more than anywhere else (West Feerrott, cell 3,4)

home.flavor: Wisps are wandering lights of the Feerrott in the Homelands, spirits with no body of their own, who wear empty armour to walk in Qeynos.

npcs.name: Elder Faintglow
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the marsh-glass bead; the spiritmaster and the coachman); a will o' wisp of the swamp at its own spot on the hill above the south pond

npcs.name: Watchlight Gleam
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), a little east of the elder, at a wisp's own spot by the pond (a sentinel stood here)

npcs.name: Lampwright Glimmer
npcs.note: the lights' outfitter, up the hill north-west of the elder (a jaguar's spot): hands over the level 1 marsh-glass bead and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol)

npcs.name: Grocer Flicker
npcs.note: trades with travellers; a Qeynos grocer's food, which a wisp carries to pass among humans

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Shimmer
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Coachman Wick
npcs.note: the swamp's stable, on the rise south-west of the elder (a spider's spot, open ground): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a light that casts has its spells; a wisp, west of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Dimlight
npcs.note: sends a wisp who has done the five starter quests to Qeynos, its rangers and druids to Surefall Glade (the quest A Shape for Qeynos)

npcs.name: bog rat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's rats (the dire rat's body, small), at the swamp creatures' spots in the reeds east of the elder

npcs.name: bog gnats
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's gnats (the mosquito swarm's body, small), at the swamp's land creatures' spots among the pools south of the elder (not the anaconda's or the alligator's: those are in the water)

npcs.name: Duskpaw
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the jaguar's body, small: a young one), alone at a jaguar's own spot north-west of the elder; hostile

Gatekeeper Dimlight: Not yet, little flame. A light that has not been tested gutters in the wind.
Do what Elder Faintglow and Watchlight Gleam ask of you. Then I will show you the way to Qeynos.
Feerrott sentinel: The swamp is dark tonight. It is always dark.
Keep your glow low, %r. Lights draw eyes.
New light? Elder Faintglow glows on the hill above the south pond.
Elder Faintglow: A light that knows where it came from never goes out.
The armour is only a shape. The light inside is you.
Watchlight Gleam: What hunts by night hunts us first. So we watch.

zones.name: South Barren Coast
zones.note: Gargoyle: the gargoyles' crags: 91 gargoyles of the game (South Barren Coast, cell 5,4)

home.flavor: Gargoyles are winged creatures of living stone from the crags of the South Barren Coast in the Homelands, who roost above Oggok.

npcs.name: Elder Gorrak
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the stonewake band; the spiritmaster and the coachman), a statue guardian, atop the crag

npcs.name: Grocer Skarn
npcs.note: the roost's grocer at the crag's foot, an Oggok grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Vorth
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Kragg
npcs.note: on the crag's south slope: sends a gargoyle who has done the starter quests to Oggok (the quest Wings to Oggok)

npcs.name: Talonmaster Krall
npcs.note: gives the three hunts (levels 3-5), beside the elder atop the crag: a gargoyle soldier

npcs.name: Hidecutter Vess
npcs.note: the roost's outfitter, atop the crag east of the elder: hands over the level 1 band and the level 4 materials; an Oggok tailor's cloth (Tailor Walth)

npcs.name: Coachman Durn
npcs.note: the roost's stable, at the crag's foot beside the grocer, west of and below the elder, facing west (the cliff is at his back): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot (the ground, not the crag's top)

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), a gargoyle atop the crag north of the elder; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: crag bat
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's bats (a vampire bat's body), round the crag's foot, south-west of it

npcs.name: cragside skink
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's skinks (the tan basilisk's body, half its size), at the zone's own creatures' spots on the barrens east of the crag

npcs.name: Grindstone
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe (the crumbling sand's body), alone at a crumbling sand's own spot on the flats north of the crag; hostile

Gatekeeper Kragg: The sky to Oggok is not yours yet, wakeling. Do what the elder and the talonmaster ask of you first.
When Krall says your stone has set, I will send you to Oggok. Not before.
Crag sentinel: Mind the edge, wakeling. Stone falls as fast as flesh.
Stand still long enough, %p, and you see everything.
Elder Gorrak: The crag remembers every stone that woke upon it.
Talonmaster Krall: Stone does not hurry. Stone does not miss.

zones.name: Goldfeather Eyrie
zones.note: The homes' shared ground (the owner, 2026-11-11: "a new zone for the higher level mobs/quest objectives ... shared by all the homeland races, so players can group together"): Tunaria's snowfield under the Goldfeather aviaks' eyrie (cell 7,3), creatures of levels 6-20 for the homes' L7-L20 quests; no race's home, a stable on the homes' coach network (every home's coach and Freeport's run to it)

npcs.name: Coachwoman Brenna
npcs.note: the shared ground's stable on the homes' coach network: every home's coach and Freeport's run here, hers to them; a rider lands on her spot, on the open ice of the frozen river (no creature within 300)

npcs.name: Warden Halvek
npcs.note: the outpost's warden, a hill giant: the homes' L15 spoils are carried to him, and he is a stop on their L20 roads

npcs.name: Quartermaster Dunmore
npcs.note: the outpost's quartermaster: hands over the homes' L10 materials; sells a Halas merchant's goods (a window: CLIENT asks a merchant for nothing else)

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Oswin
npcs.note: binds at the outpost, so a group that meets here wakes here

npcs.name: Scout Feyla
npcs.note: watches the Goldfeather eyrie from the frozen river's north-east reach: a stop on the homes' L20 roads

npcs.name: drift rat
npcs.note: L6-7 (the homes' L7 hunts): the zone's rats' spots on the snow south and east of the outpost; peaceful

npcs.name: snowfield badger
npcs.note: L7-9 (the homes' L7 hunts): the zone's badgers' spots; peaceful

npcs.name: rime spider
npcs.note: L9-11 (the homes' L10 hunts): the wooly spiders' spots; peaceful

npcs.name: pale owl
npcs.note: L10-12 (the homes' L10 hunts): the owls' spots; peaceful

npcs.name: frostpaw cub
npcs.note: L12-14 (the homes' L13 hunts): the snow leopard cubs' spots north of the river; peaceful

npcs.name: Old Frostjaw
npcs.note: L14, the homes' L13 named foe: a snow leopard's spot in the north; hostile

npcs.name: rime elemental
npcs.note: L15-17 (the homes' L15 hunts): the frost elementals' and freezing gusts' spots in the east; hostile

npcs.name: Rimeheart
npcs.note: L17, the homes' L15 named foe: an elemental at the elementals' heart in the east; hostile

npcs.name: Goldfeather raider
npcs.note: L18-20 (the homes' L20 hunts): the Goldfeather aviaks' warrior camps on the river's north reach, and the plateau round their eyrie's huts; hostile

Outpost sentry: Keep to the river ice, %p. The Goldfeathers watch the snow from their eyrie.
Every home of the Homelands sends its hunters here. Find a group before you climb.
The rime walks in the east. Do not go alone.
Warden Halvek: Hunters of every home stand this watch together, %p.
The eyrie above us is the Goldfeathers'. They do not share their snow.
Scout Feyla: Quiet. The raiders change their watch at dusk.
From here you can count their fires, %p.

zones.name: Erud's Crossing
zones.note: Mermaid: Odus's Erud's Crossing, two islands in the warm sea between Odus and Tunaria, a hut village on the northern one and Saftemoot's volcano on the southern; singing sirens, sea turtles and deep mares swim it (Erud's Crossing, cell 5,1). The game's own merfolk live under the Vastly Deep (the ratmen's home here) and in the Abysmal Sea (cell 2,4, Envar's here). Added 2026-11-11 (petition 1620, Jibrish), the 23rd zone.

home.flavor: Merfolk are the sea's own people, mermaids, sirens and mermen of the warm waters of Erud's Crossing; drawn to the scholars of Highbourne, they rise from the waves to learn beside them.

npcs.name: Elder Coralyn
npcs.note: gives the first two starter quests (the shell charm; the spiritmaster and the coachman) and the level 20 road; a mermaid of the village (her race's body), at the edge of the hut village on the island's north shore

npcs.name: Tidewarden Merrow
npcs.note: gives the hunts of levels 3-5 and 7-15, a few steps north-west of the elder: a merman (the race's male body)

npcs.name: Shellwright Pearla
npcs.note: the village's outfitter, a siren, a few steps south of the start: hands over the level 1 shell charm and the level 4 materials; a Freeport merchant's goods (Lucas Anstol)

npcs.name: Grocer Kelpa
npcs.note: the village's grocer, south-east of the start; a Highbourne grocer's food

npcs.name: Spiritmaster Nerissa
npcs.note: binds, as every spiritmaster: an enchanting siren, south-west of the start

npcs.name: Coachman Dorran
npcs.note: the village's stable at its west edge (open shore): the level 2 quest's ledger; his coach runs to Freeport and to the other homes, and a rider from them lands on his spot

npcs.name: Spell Archivist
npcs.note: the Heirloom server's Spell Archivist (handlers/archivist.go, by this name), so a novice that casts has its spells; an enchanting siren, east of the start; left out where the database has none to take wares from

npcs.name: Gatekeeper Thalassa
npcs.note: on the north shore, north-west of the village: sends one who has done the five starter quests to Highbourne (the quest The Tide to Highbourne)

npcs.name: Strand sentinel
npcs.note: the village's guards, on the hut platforms

npcs.name: shore crab
npcs.note: the level 3 quest's crabs (a rock crab's body, small), on the shore east of the village (the island's own sea wisps' and dervishes' spots)

npcs.name: strand turtle
npcs.note: the level 4 quest's turtles (the stoneshell seaturtle's body, half its size), on the hills east of the village (the island's own turtles' spots)

npcs.name: Old Shrieker
npcs.note: the level 5 quest's foe: an old harpy of the rookery at the island's far east end (the Shiran harpies' spot), alone

Gatekeeper Thalassa: Not yet, little fin. The tide carries only those who have done their village's asking.
Do what Elder Coralyn and Tidewarden Merrow ask of you. Then come back to the shore.
Strand sentinel: Mind the harpies to the east. They have long memories and short tempers.
A new face? Elder Coralyn waits at the edge of the village.
Elder Coralyn: The sea gave you to us, %p. Now the land will want you too.
Sing when you are afraid. It frightens the fear.
Tidewarden Merrow: Keep your fins wet and your eyes open.
The strand is ours, %p. Everything that crawls on it knows it.
